Subject: Launch: Lighthouse Health — S2CS kickoff & owner alignment

Hi Mina —

We closed Lighthouse this morning (signed PO attached) and they want a tight Q3 launch. Quick context: Lighthouse is a mid-market health network (90 clinics) focused on prior auth automation. Contract is 12 months, committed capacity for 6M tokens/mo after ramp. Key dates: kickoff week of Aug 24, staging access requested by Aug 25, production go-live target Oct 6.

Highlights / risks to flag for CS:
- Security: completed initial questionnaire but they will send an additional SOC2 attestation request — Vivek is on the thread for escalation.
- Data: they will provide de-identified sample payloads; expect manual mapping work for three data fields.
- Network: they need an allowlist for staging IPs (they'll send CSV).
- Commercial: we agreed to a 10% first-year ACV discount in exchange for a case study; billing PO coming from procurement.

Attachments: SOW_Lighthouse_v1.2.pdf (signed copy), PO_12345_signed.pdf (procurement).

As next steps from Sales: please own kickoff coordination and confirm who will be the primary deployment owner and the implementation PM. Jordan / Neha — can you take point and confirm your availability for a 60-min kickoff on Aug 24 or Aug 25?

Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Jordan — please mark yourself as Primary Owner and set up a 60-min kickoff with Lighthouse for Aug 24 (preferred) or Aug 25 (backup). Items to cover at kickoff: acceptance criteria, staging access plan, data samples, security/attestation timeline, escalation contacts, and success metrics.

Action items for Sales before kickoff:
- Ben: drop sample payloads and the network allowlist (CSV) into the DocSend link and share link here; confirm the PO receipt date (we have a signed copy attached but procurement confirmation helps).
